notes: Multi-turn conversation; the LAST user message is a short plain-text follow-up question (no tool_result), which is what the classifier looks at.

request.system: You are Claude Code, an interactive CLI tool for software engineering tasks.

messages.content: Why does featurise reprocess a call whose had_error_followup is still NULL?

content.text: Because had_error_followup depends on the NEXT call in the session, which may not have existed the last time featurise ran. Reprocessing lets it fill in once that next call arrives.

messages.content: and if it's the last call in the session forever?

content.text: Then it stays NULL indefinitely and gets harmlessly reprocessed (same NULL result) on every run, since there is never a next call to learn from.
